Counting the flagged lines: 3 ($638), 4 ($638), 5 ($214), 6 ($82), 10 ($9.80), 12 ($348), 13 ($96), 15 ($1,860), 19 ($6,800), 22 ($40,900), 24 ($4,200), 25 ($7,850), 36 ($18.50), 37 ($118), 38 ($612), 39 ($24), 40 ($247), 41 ($14,200), 42 ($3,870), 43 ($125), 44 ($2,200), 45 ($10,650), 47 ($6,240). All 23 flagged lines include the billed dollar amount. That is 100%, well above the 75% threshold.
